newsitem.title: CHINA: Dazhong to offer 10-for-10 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Dazhong to offer 10-for-10 bonus issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Dazhong Taxi Co have approved a proposal by the firm's board of directors for a 10-for-10 bonus issue for all shareholders, a company statement said on Saturday.

A total of 3.5-for-10 bonus shares will be based on the company's 1996 net profit and another 6.5-for-10 bonus shares will come from the company's capital reserves, the statement, published in the Shanghai Securites News, said.
The ex-rights date for all existing shares including foreign currency B shares will be June 6, the statement said.

Dazhong recorded a net profit of 110.006 million yuan in 1996, up 8.91 percent from 101.007 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards, the firm said in its 1996 annual report, released earlier.
